properties.title: ART status
properties.text: Current ART status requires a validated treatment-status resolver. No status is inferred from missing tests or historical orders.

properties.title: Current ARV regimen
properties.text: A verified current-regimen resolver is not installed. Recorded regimen history is available under ART & Regimens.

Interpretation limitation
properties.text: The regimen and reason observations are not joined into a single change event. A grouped/encounter-scoped resolver is needed for complete change history and interruptions.

properties.title: Last recorded qualitative VL result (not paired with quantitative result)
IAC and non-suppression follow-up
properties.text: Session groups, paired sample/result dates, repeat-VL-after-IAC interpretation, HIVDR context and conditional reminders require registered clinical workflow resolvers. No clinical trigger or numeric result is inferred here.

properties.title: Nutrition assessment unavailable
properties.text: The form uses a CIEL concept identifier that the current backend UUID schema rejects. No alternative identifier or nutritional status is invented.

properties.title: Assessment context
properties.text: These are separately recorded findings with observation dates, not a composite current assessment. Pregnancy/eMTCT, opportunistic infection, cervical screening and sensitive mental-health summaries require appropriate grouped context and access safeguards.

properties.title: DSDM approach pairing unavailable
properties.text: The approach must come from the same Health Education assessment and match its recorded parent model. The installed resolver cannot enforce that pairing, so no independently retrieved approach is displayed.

properties.title: Psychosocial support
properties.text: Sensitive disclosure, counselling narratives and mental-health details are not exposed by this general workspace. Review the authorized assessment form; a scoped summary resolver and access policy are required.

properties.title: Encounter details
properties.text: The current workspace contract has no authorized encounter-detail action descriptors. No destination URL is guessed.

properties.title: Launcher availability
properties.text: Forms are enabled only when the backend and installed OpenMRS form engine authorize and support launching them. The current backend reports unavailable launchers; association does not grant execution permission.

properties.title: Individual care plan unavailable
properties.text: Patient-specific goals, pending monitoring, adherence/IAC tasks and milestone completion require an authorized reminder/pathway service. Pathways remain disabled; no patient state or treatment decision is stored in this reusable definition.
